## Architecture Overview

The `component.ID` type is defined in `opentelemetry-collector/component/identifiable.go`. It is already an opaque type with private fields `typeVal` and `nameVal`, and accessor methods `Type()` and `Name()`. Factory functions `NewID()`, `MustNewID()`, `NewIDWithName()` construct IDs. Changing to a fully opaque type would break any code accessing internal fields (primarily in tests) and any code that constructs struct literals.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definition

- **`component/identifiable.go`** — Defines ID type with private fields, Type()/Name() accessors, NewID()/MustNewID()/NewIDWithName() constructors, String(), MarshalText(), UnmarshalText().
- **`component/identifiable_test.go`** — Test cases construct ID with literal syntax `ID{typeVal: validType, nameVal: ""}`.

### Pipeline ID (Similar Pattern)

- **`pipeline/pipeline.go`** — Similar opaque type for pipeline.ID.

### Key Usage in Collector Core

- **`service/internal/builders/exporter.go`** — Uses `set.ID.Type()` to access component ID type.
- **`service/internal/builders/processor.go`** — Uses `set.ID.Type()`.
- **`service/internal/graph/exporter.go`** — Uses component.ID for node management.
- **`otelcol/internal/configunmarshaler/configs.go`** — Uses `id.Type()` for factory lookups.
- **`internal/componentalias/alias.go`** — Validates component types.
- **`service/extensions/extensions_test.go`** — Constructs IDs via factory functions.

### Contrib

- **`receiver/receivercreator/config.go`** — Constructs `component.ID{}` and uses UnmarshalText().
- **`receiver/receivercreator/runner.go`** — Uses NewIDWithName() for dynamic receiver ID construction.
- **`extension/headerssetterextension/extension.go`** — Stores component.ID pointers.
- **`extension/opampextension/opamp_agent.go`** — Uses component.ID for tracking.

### Jaeger

- **`jaeger/cmd/jaeger/internal/extension/remotesampling/extension.go`** — Uses `id.Type()` method.

| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/builders/exporter.go | Uses set.ID.Type() |
| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/builders/processor.go | Uses set.ID.Type() |
| opentelemetry-collector | service/internal/graph/exporter.go | Component.ID for node management |
